entries.3d77a66aa5ffbf64: Launched in fiscal 2025, the "GCI Group Medium-Term Management Policy 2030" sets out as its desired state "Green Chemical Industry (GCI)," providing solutions globally through the power of chemistry and contributing to the sustainable growth of society. Its basic policies are rebuilding the business portfolio, expanding business domains through marketing, improving productivity and strengthening earnings capacity, and developing human resources and improving engagement to support sustainable growth. As directions to pursue, it cites "high-purity and advanced materials," centered on the electronic materials field; "environmentally responsive chemicals" as the Green field; "new business creation (high-function sugar chemicals)"; and "strengthening the management foundation."
